info.name: TravelGenix - Booking Notification API
info.description: Postman collection for testing booking notification system

request.description: Creates a booking with a driver assigned. This automatically triggers a notification to the driver via WebSocket and FCM.

body.raw:
{
  "type": "NEW_BOOKING",
  "title": "New Ride Request",
  "message": "You have received a new ride request: TG-CP-20241201-123",
  "bookingId": 123,
  "driverId": 1,
  "data": {
    "referenceId": "TG-CP-20241201-123",
    "bookerName": "John Doe",
    "bookerPhone": "+1234567890",
    "startLocation": "Colombo Airport",
    "endLocation": "Galle Fort",
    "startDate": "2024-12-15T10:00:00",
    "endDate": "2024-12-20T18:00:00",
    "estimatedCost": "375.00",
    "distance": "150.5",
    "duration": "180.0"
  }
}

request.description: Sends a notification directly to a driver without creating a booking. Replace '1' in the URL with the actual driverId.
Sends a test WebSocket notification. Requires a WebSocket client connected to ws://localhost:8089/ws subscribed to /topic/driver/1
Sends an FCM push notification directly. Replace YOUR_FCM_TOKEN_HERE with a valid FCM token from your Flutter app.
Updates a driver's FCM token. Replace '1' in the URL with the actual driverId and YOUR_FCM_TOKEN_HERE with the FCM token from Flutter app.
Retrieves a driver's FCM token. Replace '1' in the URL with the actual driverId.
Retrieves booking details by ID. Replace '123' with the actual bookingId from the create booking response.
Retrieves all bookings from the system.
